note:
Assyrian empire was proto Persian empire. Ashurbanipal, the king from 669-631BC was the youngest in line, trained as a scholar and then rose to king, probably by accident.

The Ashurbanipal library wasn't lost and sits in the British museum, with 33k tablets, many untranslated.

Mesopotamia si greek for 'between two rivers', here Tigris and Euphrates. Timeline is roughly Sumerians (3300BC-1900BC), Akkadians (2334BC-2154BC),  Assyrians (2025BC-609BC) ,  Babylonians (1894BC-539BC).
